shown.message:
I checked `candidate-v1` (`paper-repo` PR #10) against the venue, and it meets the requirements, with one risk on the page limit. I posted the full check on PR #10.

I used the system build of `dev` 327d77f, because the `pull-10` build isn't on the `document` branch yet. That commit differs from the candidate commit 625c165 only in `REPRODUCE.md`.

- **Page limit:** the main text ends on page 9 and References starts on page 10 (28 pages, US Letter).
- **Fonts:** no Type 3 font on any page.
- **Floats:** 4 figures and 3 tables in the main text, which is within my cap.
- **Style file:** `neurips_2026.sty` is identical to the skeleton commit, with no later change. I could not fetch the official kit this turn, so I could not compare it with the official copy.
- **Anonymity:** the author block is anonymous. No source file has a URL, repository name or acknowledgement that names anyone.
- **Checklist:** it is in the PDF with 41 answers (13 Yes, 6 No, 22 NA).

The risk is that page 9 is full, with a margin of about one line. The later `dev` commit 301aee3 lengthens the Table 5 caption by one clause. If the `pull-10` build puts main text on page 10 above References, prose should go first.

I did not check the checklist justifications against the paper, which is `internal-review-repo`'s part, or the anonymised code ZIP, which is `experiment-repo`'s.

Outline revision 16 changes no venue requirement. figtab's new 6 pt minimum for figure type is at the venue's `\tiny` size. The venue sets no minimum, and my 7 pt figure was a recommendation. I pushed nothing in my own repository, and issue #3 stays open.
